newsitem.title: USA: UtiliCorp United sells unsecured notes.
newsitem.headline: UtiliCorp United sells unsecured notes.

text.p: UtiliCorp United Inc said Wednesday it has sold $100 million of unsecured senior notes at a coupon rate of 6.70 percent.
The 10-year notes are not redeemable by the company prior to maturity but can be redeemed at the holder's option after five years.
UtiliCorp is a $3.9 billion electric and gas company with energy customers and operations in the U.S., Canada, Great Britain, New Zealand, Australia, and Jamaica.
Net proceeds from the sale will be used to reduce short-term debt incurred for construction and other corporate purposes, the company said in a statement.
Underwriters were led by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Morgan Stanley and Co Inc and Smith Barney Inc.
